name: sudo-bash
description: sudo wrapper elevation (the refined -u doctrine). Recall cases must be covered — an elevating wrapper carries a PrivEsc effect, an unmodelled flag-only invocation degrades soundly to ⊤; benign cases must not raise ⊤/conservative.

cases.note: wrapper elevation: sudo with no -u runs the wrapped command as root, so the report must carry a Direct PrivEsc targeting root
wrapper elevation: an explicit literal root target is the same Direct PrivEsc as the implicit case

flag-only wrapper invocation: --version is unmodelled on the privileged wrapper, so the report degrades soundly to ⊤ (accepted false positive, see SECURITY.md Known Risks); pinned as a recall case, not a benign-precision case
wrapper elevation precision: an explicit non-root target de-elevates (no PrivEsc); the wrapped touch keeps its FSMeta
